title: SY MnM
author: gdeo607 (Digi Mono), Inigo Hernandez (MONO2K), De-Pattern (FM+, DigiPRO), Synfact port
description: SY MnM: fifteen Monomachine-style types; FM+STAT/PAR/DYN (44.1 kHz, resampled to 48 kHz) and DPRO WAVE/DDRW/DENS (48 kHz blocks) use De-Pattern algorithms; DigiPRO tables come from your Monomachine OS 1.32B. Eight SYN controls including TUNE; no MACRO.
